title: {{NAME}} and the Unicorn With a Muddy Horn
moral: It is okay to ask for help when you need it.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked through the rainbow forest. The trees had pink and purple leaves. Little animals played in the soft grass. Then {{NAME}} heard a quiet sound. A unicorn sat alone by the river. She looked worried.

pages.content: The unicorn's horn was covered in mud. Her magic did not work without her clean horn. She had tried and tried to clean it. But she could not reach. She was too embarrassed to ask for help.
